name: ICDEV™ Remote Command Gateway
description: Receives commands from messaging channels (Telegram, Slack, Teams, Mattermost, internal chat), validates through 8-gate security chain, executes via ICDEV™ tools, returns classification-filtered responses.

skills.name: Receive Remote Command
skills.description: Ingest commands from messaging channels (Telegram, Slack, Teams, Mattermost, internal chat) and parse them into structured ICDEV™ tool invocations.

skills.name: Validate Security Chain
skills.description: Run the 8-gate security validation chain on incoming commands: authentication, authorization, classification check, tenant isolation, rate limiting, input sanitization, audit logging, and response filtering.

skills.name: Filter Classification
skills.description: Apply classification markings (CUI, SECRET) to outbound responses based on user clearance and tenant context.

skills.name: Multi-Channel Route
skills.description: Route responses back to the originating messaging channel with proper formatting and classification banners.
